facts.value: Arizona State University’s online Master of Science in global health prepares you to improve health for all people, in all places. Rooted in an anthropological and evolutionary approach to health, this transdisciplinary and flexible program explores how culture, history, biology and the environment interact to shape health outcomes across time and place.
